title: 第三章 开学典礼上的异动第四章 元素教室的初次碰撞
lines: 第三章开学典礼上的异动
斯卡市的晨光总带着魔法特有的鎏金色泽，当第一缕光线越过幻境学院的尖顶塔楼，整个校园仿佛被注入了流动的能量。今天是新生开学典礼的日子，主广场上早已挤满了来自不同国度的少年少女，空气中漂浮着各色元素粒子——灵都国学子袖口溢出的草绿色光点，魔法国少年周身跳动的橙红色火苗，镜幻国少女发间流转的银白镜光，还有幻灵国本土学生身上稳定的淡蓝色元素波动，像一幅被打翻的调色盘，在青石地面上交织出绚烂的纹路。
林澈站在人群边缘，指尖无意识地摩挲着胸前的入学徽章。徽章是用幻境学院特有的“记忆水晶”制成，冰凉的触感下藏着微弱的能量脉动，这是他三天前第一次踏入斯卡市时，从未感受过的密集魔法场。他来自幻灵国南部的一个小镇，那里的魔法稀薄到几乎可以忽略，若不是半年前在一次塌方中意外觉醒了“空间感知”——能隐约察觉到物体周围的空间褶皱，他恐怕这辈子都不会与这座大陆闻名的魔法学府产生交集。
“让一让，麻烦让一让！”
一个清脆的女声伴随着急促的脚步声传来，林澈下意识地侧身，只见一个穿着灵都国传统刺绣长裙的少女正抱着一摞厚重的典籍，在人群中艰难地穿梭。她的头发是罕见的浅碧色，发尾系着几颗圆润的珍珠，跑动时珍珠碰撞着发出细碎的声响，更衬得她脸颊因着急而泛起的红晕格外显眼。
“抱歉抱歉，”少女在林澈面前停下脚步，有些不好意思地捋了捋被风吹乱的鬓发，“我是苏璃，灵都国来的。导师让我把这些古籍送到**台，没想到人这么多……”
她的话音未落，一阵灼热的气浪突然从斜后方涌来，伴随着金属碰撞的刺耳声。林澈的空间感知瞬间被触动，他清晰地“看到”一团扭曲的火焰正朝着苏璃怀中的典籍扑去，而火焰的源头，是一个穿着魔法国战士装束的少年——他腰间的佩剑不知为何被点燃了，火苗正顺着剑鞘疯狂蔓延。
“小心！”
林澈几乎是本能地伸手，他并未接触到火焰，而是凭着感知在那团火焰周围的空间轻轻一“捏”。奇妙的事情发生了：那团原本要吞噬典籍的火焰，像是撞进了一个无形的口袋，猛地向内收缩，最后“噗”地一声熄灭在半空中，只留下一缕青烟。
苏璃惊得捂住了嘴，怀里的典籍险些滑落。而那个魔法国少年则一脸错愕地看着自己的佩剑，又看看林澈，眉头紧锁：“你做了什么？”
“凯！注意你的态度！”一个清冷的声音从旁边传来。林澈转头，看到一个穿着镜幻国服饰的少女正站在不远处，她的衣服上绣满了细碎的银线，在阳光下折射出如同镜面般的光泽。少女的眼睛是浅灰色的，瞳孔里仿佛藏着无数个细碎的影子，她看向林澈时，目光似乎穿透了他的身体，落在了更远的地方，“是你的火焰失控在先，这位同学只是帮你稳住了能量。”
凯显然不太服气，但看了一眼少女，还是悻悻地收起了佩剑。他的家族是魔法国有名的火焰战士世家，自幼便以掌控烈焰为傲，刚才那下失控对他而言无疑是种羞辱。
苏璃这才缓过神，连忙对林澈道谢：“太感谢你了！这些古籍是记载着灵都国植物魔法起源的孤本，要是被烧坏了……”
“举手之劳。”林澈摇摇头，他能感觉到自己刚才那一下消耗了不少精神力，指尖有些发麻。他看向那个镜幻国少女，“你怎么知道是他的火焰失控？”
少女没有立刻回答，而是抬眼望向**台上方的穹顶。那里悬挂着一面巨大的水晶镜，是幻境学院的标志性建筑之一，据说能映照出参观者内心最真实的想法。此刻，水晶镜的表面正泛起一圈圈不规则的涟漪，像是被投入了石子的湖面。
“镜子告诉我的。”少女轻声说，浅灰色的眼眸里闪过一丝复杂的情绪，“它刚才晃了一下，里面有团火在乱撞。”
就在这时，广场前方传来一阵骚动。原本应该主持典礼的院长还未出现，取而代之的是几位神色凝重的导师，他们正快步走上**台，其中一位穿着深蓝色长袍、胸前别着“空间系首席导师”徽章的中年男人，正低声与旁边的人交谈着什么，他的手指无意识地在空气中画着复杂的符文，显然是在维持某种结界。
“怎么回事？院长呢？”
“看导师们的表情，好像出事了……”
人群中的议论声越来越大，各种魔法波动开始变得紊乱。林澈的空间感知再次被触发，这一次，他感觉到的不是某个小范围的空间褶皱，而是整个广场下方，有一股极其微弱但异常阴冷的能量正在缓慢渗透，像是蛇一样顺着石板的缝隙蔓延。
“你们有没有觉得……有点冷？”苏璃下意识地抱紧了怀里的典籍，浅碧色的发丝间渗出几缕细小的藤蔓，这是灵都国魔法师感到不安时的本能反应。
凯也皱起了眉，他重新握住了剑柄，这次没有火焰燃起，反而有一层薄薄的寒霜爬上了剑鞘——这与他的火焰属性截然相反，显然是受到了外界能量的干扰。
镜幻国少女的目光死死盯着那面水晶镜。此刻，镜面的涟漪越来越剧烈，原本清晰的倒影开始扭曲、重叠，隐约能看到无数破碎的影子在里面挣扎，其中一个影子穿着与导师们相似的长袍，正朝着镜面外伸出手，仿佛在求救。
一声沉闷的钟鸣从学院深处传来，打断了所有的议论。这是幻境学院的“警示钟”，按照校规，只有在遭遇重大危机时才会敲响。随着钟声落下，**台上的空间系导师猛地抬起手，一道深蓝色的光幕瞬间笼罩了整个广场，将所有学生与外界隔绝开来。
“所有人保持冷静！”导师的声音通过魔法扩音器传遍广场，带着不容置疑的威严，“学院古籍库发生能量异常，院长正在处理，典礼暂时推迟。请各国领队带领学生返回宿舍，没有指令不得擅自离开！”
人群中顿时一片哗然。古籍库是学院存放珍贵文献的地方，也是防御最严密的区域之一，能让那里出现“能量异常”，显然不是小事。林澈注意到，导师说这话时，目光飞快地扫过广场上的某个方向，而那个方向，正是凯和镜幻国少女所在的位置。
苏璃怀里的古籍突然发出一阵轻微的震动，其中一本封面绣着藤蔓花纹的书，封面上的花纹竟然开始自主游走，最后汇聚成一个模糊的符号——林澈认得这个符号，在他入学前收到的录取通知书上，也曾有过一个一模一样的印记。
“这个符号……”苏璃的脸色变得苍白，“我在祖父的笔记里见过，据说与‘秘境钥匙’有关。”
凯的佩剑再次发出了嗡鸣，这次不再是火焰或寒霜，而是浮现出一行古老的魔法国文字，翻译成通用语是：“暗影将至，守护者集结”。
镜幻国少女猛地转头看向林澈，浅灰色的眼眸里第一次出现了清晰的情绪，那是一种混杂着震惊与了然的神色：“你的空间感知，是不是能看到别人看不到的线？”
林澈一愣，下意识地点头。他确实能看到一些无形的“线”，这些线连接着不同的物体，构成了空间的骨架，刚才扑灭火焰时，他就是捏住了火焰与空气之间的一条线。
“那不是普通的线，”少女的声音压得很低，只有他们四人能听到，“那是秘境的‘脉络’。水晶镜刚才告诉我，有四股力量在今天觉醒，而这四股力量，正好对应着开启秘境的四把钥匙。”
她的话刚说完，林澈胸前的记忆水晶徽章突然变得滚烫，里面原本黯淡的纹路开始发光，与苏璃古籍上的符号、凯佩剑上的文字、以及少女眼中闪过的镜光，同时亮起，形成了一个完美的四芒星图案。
广场外传来一阵更加强烈的能量波动，连空间系导师布下的光幕都泛起了涟漪。林澈的空间感知中，那股阴冷的能量已经突破了学院的外层防御，正朝着广场的方向快速逼近，而在那股能量的源头，他“看”到了一个模糊的黑影，手里似乎握着什么东西，那东西散发的气息，与古籍库的方向隐隐呼应。
“看来，我们想回宿舍也不容易了。”凯握紧了佩剑，火焰终于重新在他掌心燃起，但这次的火焰不再失控，反而带着一种前所未有的稳定，“不管是什么东西要来，总得先问问我的剑同意不同意。”
苏璃深吸一口气，怀里的古籍停止了震动，但那藤蔓符号却变得越发清晰。她看向林澈和镜幻国少女，浅碧色的眼眸里闪烁着坚定的光芒：“灵都国的谚语说，‘藤蔓在风暴中结成网’。既然我们的力量产生了共鸣，或许……我们应该一起面对。”
镜幻国少女点了点头，抬手拂过发间的银线，她的指尖掠过之处，空气里浮现出无数细小的镜片，这些镜片悬浮在空中，形成了一个简易的侦查阵：“我的镜像能看到三百米内的动静，那股阴冷能量里，藏着不止一个影子。”
林澈看着三人，又低头看了看胸前发烫的徽章。他能感觉到，那些连接着空间的“线”正在剧烈震颤，仿佛有什么尘封已久的东西即将被唤醒。广场外的能量波动越来越强，光幕上的涟漪如同惊涛骇浪，而远处的古籍库方向，隐约有红光冲天而起。
他知道，这场看似意外的“异动”，恐怕只是一个开始。而他们四个来自不同国度、天赋各异的新生，因为这场异动被无形地联系在一起，即将卷入一场远超他们想象的风暴之中——这场风暴的中心，或许就是那个只存在于传说中的“秘境”。
警示钟再次敲响，这一次，钟声里夹杂着隐约的破碎声，仿佛有什么重要的东西，已经在古籍库那边彻底碎裂了。**台上的导师们脸色愈发凝重，开始低声吟唱更复杂的防御咒语，而林澈四人相视一眼，不约而同地朝着广场边缘的一个隐蔽角落退去——那里的空间波动相对稳定，却也是最容易被忽略的地方，正好适合他们暂时隐藏，观察局势的变化。
阳光依旧明媚，但幻境学院的空气中，已经弥漫开一种山雨欲来的紧张气息。开学典礼的异动，像一颗投入湖面的石子，不仅打破了平静，更在水面之下，唤醒了沉睡已久的暗流。

Chapter 3: Strange Movements at the Opening Ceremony
The morning light in Ska City always carries the unique gilded luster of magic. When the first ray of light passes over the spire tower of Illusion Academy, the entire campus seems to be injected with flowing energy. Today is the day of the freshman's opening ceremony. The main square is already crowded with boys and girls from different countries. There are particles of various elements floating in the air - the grass-green light spots spilling from the sleeves of the students from the Kingdom of Spirit, the orange-red flames dancing around the boys from the Kingdom of Magic, the silver mirror light flowing in the hair of the girls from the Kingdom of Mirror Fantasy, and the steady fluctuations of light blue elements from the local students from the Phantom Kingdom, like an overturned palette, interweaving gorgeous patterns on the bluestone ground.
Lin Che stood on the edge of the crowd, her fingertips unconsciously rubbing the admission badge on her chest. The badge is made of the unique "memory crystal" of Illusion Academy. There is a weak pulse of energy hidden under the cold touch. This is a dense magic field that he has never felt when he first stepped into Ska City three days ago. He comes from a small town in the southern part of the Phantom Kingdom, where the magic is so thin that it is almost negligible. If he hadn't accidentally awakened his "spatial perception" in a landslide half a year ago - he can vaguely detect the folds of space around objects, he might never have interacted with the famous magic school on this continent in his life.
"Give way, please give way!"
A clear female voice came along with the sound of hurried footsteps. Lin Che subconsciously turned sideways and saw a girl wearing a traditional embroidered dress from the Lingdu Kingdom, holding a stack of heavy classics and struggling through the crowd. Her hair was a rare light blue color, with a few round pearls tied at the end. When she ran, the pearls collided and made a tiny sound, which made the blush on her cheeks due to worry stand out.
"Sorry, sorry," the girl stopped in front of Lin Che, and stroking her hair that was messed up by the wind with some embarrassment, "I am Su Li, from Lingdu Kingdom. My instructor asked me to deliver these ancient books to the platform, but I didn't expect there to be so many people..."
Before she finished speaking, a wave of hot air suddenly surged from behind, accompanied by the harsh sound of metal colliding. Lin Che's spatial perception was instantly triggered. He clearly "saw" a twisted flame rushing towards the tome in Su Li's arms. The source of the flame was a young man wearing the uniform of a Magic Kingdom warrior. The sword at his waist was ignited for some reason, and the flames were spreading crazily along the scabbard.
"Be careful!"
Lin Che stretched out her hand almost instinctively. He did not touch the flame, but simply "pinched" the space around the flame based on his perception. A wonderful thing happened: the flame that was originally going to devour the classics seemed to have crashed into an invisible pocket, suddenly shrank inward, and finally extinguished in mid-air with a "pop", leaving only a wisp of smoke.
Su Li covered her mouth in shock, and the classics in her arms almost slipped. The boy from the Magic Kingdom looked at his sword in astonishment, then looked at Lin Che, his brows furrowed: "What did you do?"
"Kai! Pay attention to your attitude!" A cold voice came from the side. Lin Che turned around and saw a girl wearing Jing Huan Kingdom clothing standing not far away. Her clothes were embroidered with fine silver threads, which reflected a mirror-like luster in the sunlight. The girl's eyes were light gray, and there seemed to be countless tiny shadows hidden in her pupils. When she looked at Lin Che, her eyes seemed to penetrate his body and fall farther away. "It was your flames that lost control first. This classmate just helped you stabilize the energy."
Kai was obviously not convinced, but he glanced at the girl and put away his sword angrily. His family is a famous family of flame warriors in the Magic Kingdom. They have been proud of controlling the flames since childhood. The loss of control just now was undoubtedly a humiliation for him.
Su Li calmed down and quickly thanked Lin Che: "Thank you so much! These ancient books are the only ones recording the origin of plant magic in Lingdu Kingdom. If they are burned..."
"It takes a little effort." Lin Che shook her head. He could feel that he had consumed a lot of mental energy just now, and his fingertips were a little numb. He looked at the girl from Mirror Fantasy Country, "How do you know it was his flames that were out of control?"
The girl did not answer immediately, but raised her eyes to look at the dome above the platform. There is a huge crystal mirror hanging there, which is one of the landmark buildings of Fantasy Academy. It is said to reflect the truest thoughts of visitors. At this moment, irregular ripples appeared on the surface of the crystal mirror, like a lake where stones had been thrown into it.
"The mirror told me." The girl said softly, a complex emotion flashed in her light gray eyes, "It shook just now, and there was a ball of fire inside."
At this moment, there was a commotion in front of the square. The dean who was supposed to preside over the ceremony has not yet appeared. Instead, there are several solemn-looking instructors who are walking quickly onto the stage. One of them, a middle-aged man wearing a dark blue robe and a "Chief Instructor of the Space Department" badge on his chest, is talking in a low voice to the people next to him. His fingers are unconsciously drawing complex runes in the air, obviously maintaining some kind of enchantment.
"What's going on? Where is the dean?"
"Looking at the expressions of the instructors, it seems something has happened..."
The chatter among the crowd became louder and louder, and various magic fluctuations began to become chaotic. Lin Che's space perception was triggered again. This time, what he felt was not a small-scale spatial fold, but an extremely weak but unusually cold energy was slowly seeping underneath the entire square, spreading like a snake along the gaps in the stone slabs.
"Do you feel... a little cold?" Su Li subconsciously hugged the classics in her arms tightly. A few strands of tiny vines seeped out from her light green hair. This was the instinctive reaction of a magician from the Lingdu Kingdom when he felt uneasy.
Kai also frowned, and he held the hilt of the sword again. This time, no flames ignited, but instead a thin layer of frost climbed onto the scabbard - this was completely opposite to his flame attribute, and was obviously interfered with by external energy.
The girl from Jing Huan Kingdom stared at the crystal mirror. At this moment, the ripples on the mirror became more and more intense, and the originally clear reflections began to distort and overlap. Countless broken shadows could be vaguely seen struggling inside. One of the shadows was wearing a robe similar to the mentors and was reaching out to the outside of the mirror, as if asking for help.
"Dong——"
A dull bell sounded from deep inside the academy, interrupting all discussions. This is the "warning bell" of Fantasy Academy. According to school rules, it will only sound when encountering a major crisis. As the bell fell, the space department instructor on the stage suddenly raised his hand, and a dark blue light curtain instantly enveloped the entire square, isolating all students from the outside world.
"Everyone, stay calm!" The instructor's voice spread throughout the square through the magic loudspeaker, with unquestionable majesty. "There is an energy abnormality in the ancient book library of the college. The dean is handling it. The ceremony is temporarily postponed. Please lead the leaders of each country to lead the students back to the dormitory. They are not allowed to leave without permission!"
There was an uproar among the crowd. The ancient book library is where the academy stores precious documents, and it is also one of the most heavily defended areas. It is obviously not a trivial matter to cause "energy anomalies" to occur there. Lin Che noticed that when the instructor said this, his eyes quickly scanned a certain direction in the square, and that direction was exactly where Kai and the girl from Jinghuan Country were.
The ancient books in Su Li's arms suddenly vibrated slightly. One of the books had a vine pattern embroidered on the cover. The pattern on the cover began to wander on its own, and finally converged into a vague symbol - Lin Che recognized this symbol. There was an exact mark on the admission notice he received before enrolling.
"This symbol..." Su Li's face turned pale, "I saw it in my grandfather's notes. It is said to be related to the 'Secret Realm Key'."
Kai's sword buzzed again, this time it was no longer fire or frost, but a line of ancient Magic Kingdom text emerged, translated into common language: "The Shadow is Coming, the Guardians Gather."
The girl from Jing Huan Country suddenly turned her head to look at Lin Che. For the first time, clear emotions appeared in her light gray eyes. It was a look that was mixed with shock and understanding: "Can you see lines that others can't see with your spatial perception?"
Lin Che was stunned and nodded subconsciously. He could indeed see some invisible "lines" that connected different objects and formed the skeleton of space. When he put out the flames just now, he pinched a line between the flames and the air.
"That's not an ordinary thread," the girl's voice was so low that only the four of them could hear it, "that's the 'vein' of the secret realm. The crystal mirror just told me that four forces awakened today, and these four forces correspond to the four keys that open the secret realm."
As soon as she finished speaking, the memory crystal badge on Lin Che's chest suddenly became hot, and the originally dim lines inside began to glow. Together with the symbols on Su Li's ancient book, the words on Kai's sword, and the mirror light flashing in the girl's eyes, they lit up at the same time, forming a perfect four-pointed star pattern.
An even stronger energy fluctuation came from outside the square, and even the light curtain set up by the space department instructor rippled. In Lin Che's spatial perception, the cold energy had broken through the outer defense of the college and was rapidly approaching in the direction of the square. At the source of the energy, he "saw" a vague black figure, which seemed to be holding something in his hand. The aura of that thing vaguely echoed the direction of the ancient book library.
"It seems that it will not be easy for us to return to the dormitory." Kai tightened his grip on the sword, and the flame finally ignited in his palm again, but this time the flame was no longer out of control, but with an unprecedented stability. "No matter what is coming, you must first ask if my sword agrees."
Su Li took a deep breath, and the ancient book in her arms stopped shaking, but the vine symbol became clearer and clearer. She looked at Lin Che and the girl from Jinghuan Kingdom, her light green eyes flashing with determination: "The proverb of Lingdu Kingdom says, 'vines form a web in the storm.' Since our powers resonate, maybe... we should face it together."
The girl from the Kingdom of Mirrors nodded and raised her hand to brush the silver threads in her hair. Wherever her fingertips passed, countless tiny lenses appeared in the air. These lenses were suspended in the air, forming a simple detection array: "My mirror image can see movement within three hundred meters. There is more than one shadow hidden in that cold energy."
Lin Che looked at the three of them, then looked down at the hot badge on her chest. He could feel that the "lines" connecting the spaces were vibrating violently, as if something that had been dusty for a long time was about to be awakened. The energy fluctuations outside the square are getting stronger and stronger, the ripples on the light screen are like stormy waves, and in the distance in the direction of the ancient book library, there is a faint red light rising into the sky.
He knew that this seemingly unexpected "change" was probably just the beginning. And the four freshmen, who come from different countries and have different talents, are invisibly connected because of this change, and are about to be involved in a storm far beyond their imagination - the center of this storm may be the "secret realm" that only exists in legends.
The warning bell rang again. This time, the bell was mixed with a faint sound of breaking, as if something important had been completely shattered in the ancient book library. The faces of the instructors on the stage became more solemn and they began to whisper more complex defensive spells. Lin Che and the four of them looked at each other and retreated towards a hidden corner at the edge of the square. The spatial fluctuations there were relatively stable, but it was also the most easily ignored place. It was just right for them to hide temporarily and observe the changes in the situation.
The sun is still shining brightly, but the air of Fantasy Academy is already filled with a tense atmosphere of impending rain. The unusual movement at the opening ceremony was like a stone thrown into the lake. It not only broke the calm, but also awakened the long-dormant undercurrent under the water.
